description: This source file defines AnsiEncoding, a class implementing text encoding and decoding for the Windows-1252 (CP-1252) legacy encoding, specifically used for PDF processing within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: AnsiEncoding
classes.description: A sealed class that extends Encoding to provide support for Windows-1252 (CP-1252) encoding for PDF text processing.

methods.name: GetByteCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes required to encode a sequence of characters.

methods.name: GetBytes
methods.description: Encodes a set of characters into a sequence of bytes.

methods.name: GetCharCount
methods.description: Returns the number of characters produced by decoding a sequence of bytes.

methods.name: GetChars
methods.description: Decodes a sequence of bytes into a set of characters.

methods.name: GetMaxByteCount
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of bytes that can be produced by encoding a given number of characters.

methods.name: GetMaxCharCount
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of characters that can be produced by decoding a given number of bytes.

methods.name: IsAnsi
methods.description: Checks if a given Unicode character can be represented in the Windows-1252 encoding.

methods.name: IsAnsi
methods.description: Checks if a string can be represented entirely within the Windows-1252 encoding.

methods.name: IsAnsi
methods.description: Checks if an array of code points are all representable in Windows-1252.

methods.name: UnicodeToAnsi
methods.description: Maps a Unicode character to its corresponding Windows-1252 byte, or returns a fallback character if no mapping exists.
